subject: general
question: In which of the following years was Amazon.in launched in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2013**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Amazon.in was officially launched in India in **June 2013**, marking Amazon's entry into the Indian e-commerce market.
 
• Initially, Amazon.in started by offering books, movies, and TV shows for sale and gradually expanded its product categories.
 
• India was a significant market for Amazon due to its growing internet penetration and the rise of online shopping.
 
• The company faced stiff competition from local e-commerce platforms like Flipkart and Snapdeal, but it quickly gained traction.
 
• Amazon.in introduced services like **Amazon Prime** in 2016 and **Amazon Pay** to strengthen its position in the Indian market.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Category-Specific Alternatives**

 
 
• Fashion: Myntra, Ajio, Tata CLiQ, and specialized sites like Bewakoof.
 
• Beauty: Nykaa (beauty & wellness).
 
• Electronics: Croma and Newegg.
 
• Groceries: BigBasket and JioMart.
